summary: Iteration 65: Bug Fix Verification - Admin 'não autenticado' error on /tech/visitas. ALL 4 TESTS PASSED. The axios interceptor fix correctly allows auto-refresh for admin users accessing /tech/* endpoints when they have a valid refresh token, while still blocking refresh for real technicians (who don't have refresh tokens).
critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor fix is correct: shouldSkipRefreshForTechEndpoint = isTechEndpoint && (currentUserKind === 'tech' || !refreshToken)
Admin users (kind='admin') with valid refresh tokens will trigger auto-refresh on /tech/* endpoints
Tech users (kind='tech') without refresh tokens will NOT trigger auto-refresh (expected behavior)
Session probes (/auth/me, /tech/auth/me) are correctly excluded from refresh logic
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for admin 'não autenticado' error on /tech/visitas verified. The interceptor now correctly handles admin users accessing tech portal endpoints by allowing auto-refresh when they have a valid refresh token. Key session storage keys: obelisco_access_token_session, obelisco_refresh_token_session, obelisco_user_kind_session (values: 'admin' or 'tech').

test_1_admin_direct_access.description: Login as admin and access /tech/visitas directly
test_1_admin_direct_access.details: Admin can access /tech/visitas without any authentication errors

test_2_admin_auto_refresh.description: Admin with invalid access token but valid refresh token accessing /tech/visitas
test_2_admin_auto_refresh.details: Interceptor correctly triggers auto-refresh, new access token is obtained, page loads successfully

test_3_admin_obra_path.description: Admin accessing /tech/visitas via obra button (with workId parameter) after token invalidation
test_3_admin_obra_path.details: Auto-refresh works correctly for the obra path entry point as well

test_4_tecnico_regression.description: Técnico (real technician) login and access /tech/visitas normally
test_4_tecnico_regression.details: Técnico has no refresh token (refresh_token: null), user_kind: 'tech', and can still access /tech/visitas normally without triggering refresh logic

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Admin users getting 'não autenticado' error when accessing /tech/visitas in production
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Axios interceptor was treating all /tech/* endpoints as 'no refresh allowed', which broke admins with expired access tokens inside the Tech Portal
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Interceptor now uses user kind (from sessionStorage) + refresh token availability to determine if refresh should be skipped. Only skips for real technicians (kind='tech') or when no refresh token is available
bug_fix_verification.verification_status: VERIFIED - All scenarios tested and working correctly
